subcategory_text: Analyse the root cause of each remediated vulnerability to identify systemic gaps (e.g., missing controls, training, tooling, or process) and inform improvements.
implementation_examples: Perform root-cause analysis (5 Whys, fishbone) for critical vulnerabilities
Identify whether the root cause is process, training, tool, or design
Track root-cause findings as inputs to SSDF practice improvements
assessment_objectives: Determine whether root-cause analysis is performed on remediated vulnerabilities.
Determine whether systemic findings feed back into SSDF practice improvements.
